title: Your Rental Car CRM: Text and Email Automations Through the Process

sections.label: 1 - NEW RENTAL INQUIRY
sections.note: The first of your text and email automations: someone asks about a car, gets a text back in seconds and an email with what they need to rent, and a follow-up the next day if they have not booked. The card opens under New Inquiry, the first of your headings in the opportunities tab, and texts go out once your GHL number's A2P registration is approved.

sections.label: 2 - BOOKING CONFIRMED
sections.note: When you confirm the booking, the renter gets the confirmation by text and email with the deposit, the agreement and your rules on tolls and tickets, and you get a task to verify license and insurance before pickup.

sections.label: 3 - CAR RETURNED
sections.note: When the car comes back, the renter gets a thank-you, you get an inspection task that feeds your Vehicles and Maintenance tabs, and two days later the review request goes out unless a claim is open.

sections.label: 4 - ACCIDENT REPORTED
sections.note: The renter gets a safety-first text and an email listing everything the claim needs, you get a text, and the card sits in Accident or Claim with a record in your Accidents/Claims tab until it is settled.

sections.label: 5 - TICKET RECEIVED
sections.note: Parking, toll and camera tickets show up after the car is back, so this one runs off the renter, not the open rental: ticket details, your admin fee and a payment link, a record in your Tickets tab, and one reminder if it is still unpaid.

nodes.label: 1 - Rental Inquiry Comes In: rental-inquiry Tag Added
nodes.notes: Your inquiry form, a Facebook lead or you after a phone call adds this one tag, and everything below runs from it.

nodes.label: 2 - Clear rental-inquiry So Their Next Inquiry Fires Again
nodes.notes: Repeat renters are normal: every workflow clears its own tag first, so a renter's next rental runs all of this again.

nodes.label: 3 - Open the Card Under New Inquiry
nodes.notes: This step carries your opportunities tab headings, New Inquiry through Lost, in rental order.

nodes.label: 4 - Text Back: Which Dates and Which Car

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, thanks for reaching out to {{location.name}} about a rental car. What dates do you need it, and is there a car you have in mind? Reply here and we will check what is available.

nodes.label: 5 - Email: What You Need to Rent With Us

params.subject: What you need to rent a car with {{location.name}}
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, thanks for your interest in renting with {{location.name}}. So you are ready to go once we confirm your dates, here is what we need before pickup: a photo of your driver's license, front and back; proof of full-coverage auto insurance, like your insurance card or declarations page; a security deposit of {{custom_values.security_deposit}}, held during the rental and released after the car is returned and inspected; and your signed rental agreement, here: {{custom_values.rental_agreement_link}}. Reply to this email or text us your dates and the photos, and we will get you booked. {{location.name}}

nodes.label: 6 - Text You the New Inquiry

params.message: New rental inquiry: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}, {{contact.phone}}. Car: {{contact.rental_vehicle}}. Dates: {{contact.pickup_date}} to {{contact.return_date}}. They got the text and the what-you-need email. The card is under New Inquiry.

nodes.label: 7 - Wait 1 Day
8 - Text: Still Need a Car?

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, checking in on your rental with {{location.name}}. Do you still need a car? Send your pickup and return dates and we will see what is open for you.

nodes.label: 9 - Goal: They Booked, So No Follow-Up Text
nodes.notes: The moment you add rental-booked, even mid-wait, the renter jumps here and the follow-up never goes out.

nodes.label: 10 - You Confirm the Booking: rental-booked Tag Added
11 - Clear rental-booked for Their Next Rental
12 - Move the Card to Booked - Docs Needed
13 - Text: You Are Booked, Send License and Insurance

params.message: You are booked, {{contact.first_name}}! {{contact.rental_vehicle}}, pickup {{contact.pickup_date}}, return {{contact.return_date}}. To lock it in, reply to this text with a photo of your driver's license (front and back) and your insurance card. Full details are in your email. {{location.name}}

nodes.label: 14 - Email: Confirmation, Deposit, Agreement and Rental Rules
nodes.notes: Tolls and tickets are spelled out before pickup, so the ticket texts in section 5 are never a surprise.

params.subject: Your rental is booked: {{contact.rental_vehicle}} on {{contact.pickup_date}}
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, your rental with {{location.name}} is confirmed. Car: {{contact.rental_vehicle}}. Pickup: {{contact.pickup_date}} at {{custom_values.pickup_address}}. Return: {{contact.return_date}}, same place, with the same fuel level you picked it up with. Before pickup we need four things: a photo of your driver's license, front and back; proof of full-coverage insurance; your signed rental agreement at {{custom_values.rental_agreement_link}}; and your security deposit of {{custom_values.security_deposit}}, paid here: {{custom_values.payment_link}}. The deposit is released after the car is returned and inspected. So there are no surprises: tolls, parking tickets and camera tickets during your rental are billed to you, plus a {{custom_values.ticket_admin_fee}} admin fee. If anything happens on the road, call or text {{custom_values.after_hours_phone}} right away. Reply here with any questions. {{location.name}}

nodes.label: 15 - Task: Verify License, Insurance and Deposit Before Pickup

params.title: Verify {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} before pickup on {{contact.pickup_date}}: license, insurance, agreement, deposit
params.description: Check the license is valid and matches the renter, the insurance is full coverage and current, the agreement is signed and the deposit is in. Then drag the card to Ready for Pickup, and to On Rent when you hand over the keys.

nodes.label: 16 - Car Comes Back: vehicle-returned Tag Added
17 - Clear vehicle-returned for Their Next Rental
18 - Move the Card to Returned - Inspection
19 - Text: Thanks, Deposit Released After Inspection

params.message: Thanks for renting with {{location.name}}, {{contact.first_name}}! We have the {{contact.rental_vehicle}} back. We will do a quick inspection and release your deposit once it is done.

nodes.label: 20 - Task: Inspect, Log Mileage, Check If Service Is Due
nodes.notes: Every return feeds your Vehicles and Maintenance tabs: new mileage on the car, a service record when one is due.

params.title: Inspect the {{contact.rental_vehicle}} returned by {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
params.description: Photos of all four sides, the interior and the dash. Check the fuel and write down the odometer. Update Current Mileage on the car's record in the Vehicles tab, and add a record in the Maintenance tab if service is due. Clean: release the deposit. New damage: open a record in the Accidents/Claims tab and add the claim-open tag to the renter, which holds the review request.

nodes.label: 21 - Wait 2 Days While You Inspect
22 - Claim Open on This Rental?
23 - Yes: Stop Here, No Review Ask During a Claim
24 - No: Move the Card to Rental Completed
25 - Send Your Review Request
26 - Renter Reports an Accident: accident-reported Tag Added
27 - Clear accident-reported for Any Future Report
28 - Tag claim-open Until the Claim Is Settled
nodes.notes: Stays on the renter until you remove it when the claim is paid, and holds the review request in section 3.

nodes.label: 29 - Move the Card to Accident or Claim
30 - Text: Are You Safe, Then Photos and Police Report

params.message: {{contact.first_name}}, we are sorry to hear about the accident. First, are you safe? If anyone is hurt, call 911. Then please take photos of both cars, the scene, and the other driver's license, plate and insurance card, ask for the police report number, and do not admit fault. Text the photos to this number. Need us now? Call {{custom_values.after_hours_phone}}. {{location.name}}

nodes.label: 31 - Email: Everything We Need to Open the Claim

params.subject: Accident in the {{contact.rental_vehicle}}: what we need to open the claim
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, so we can open the claim, please reply to this email with: the date, time and address of the accident; a short description of what happened; the police report number and which department took it; the other driver's name, phone, insurance company and policy number; your own auto insurance company and policy number; and every photo you took. Keep any paperwork you were handed at the scene. We will keep you updated as the claim moves. {{location.name}}

nodes.label: 32 - Text You the Accident Right Away

params.message: Accident reported: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} ({{contact.phone}}) in the {{contact.rental_vehicle}}. They have the safety text and the claim email. The card is in Accident or Claim and they are tagged claim-open.

nodes.label: 33 - Task: Open the Accidents/Claims Record and Call Your Insurer

params.title: Open an Accidents/Claims record: {{contact.rental_vehicle}}, {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
params.description: Link the record to the renter and the car, add the police report number, the other driver's insurer and the photos, and call your insurer. Set the car's Status in the Vehicles tab to Out of Service until it is repaired. Remove the claim-open tag when the claim is settled.

nodes.label: 34 - A Ticket Comes In: ticket-received Tag Added
nodes.notes: Fill Ticket Type, Number, Date and Amount on the renter, then add the tag; the text and email pull them in.

nodes.label: 35 - Clear ticket-received for the Next Ticket
36 - Clear an Old ticket-paid Tag
37 - Text the Renter the Ticket and the Fee

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, this is {{location.name}}. We received a {{contact.ticket_type}} ticket, number {{contact.ticket_number}}, dated {{contact.ticket_date}}, for {{contact.ticket_amount}} from your rental. Per your rental agreement it is billed to you plus a {{custom_values.ticket_admin_fee}} admin fee. Details are in your email, and you can pay here: {{custom_values.payment_link}}

nodes.label: 38 - Email: Ticket Details and Your Payment Link

params.subject: Ticket from your rental: {{contact.ticket_type}}, {{contact.ticket_date}}
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, we received a ticket issued while you had one of our cars. Type: {{contact.ticket_type}}. Ticket number: {{contact.ticket_number}}. Date: {{contact.ticket_date}}. Amount: {{contact.ticket_amount}}. Under your rental agreement, tickets and tolls during the rental are the renter's responsibility, plus a {{custom_values.ticket_admin_fee}} admin fee for handling it. You can pay here: {{custom_values.payment_link}}. If you think this ticket is not yours, reply with your rental dates and we will check it against our records. {{location.name}}

nodes.label: 39 - Task: Log It in the Tickets Tab, Transfer or Pay
nodes.notes: Every ticket becomes a record in your Tickets tab, linked to the car and the renter who had it that day.

params.title: Log the {{contact.ticket_type}} ticket {{contact.ticket_number}} in the Tickets tab
params.description: Link it to the car and to {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}. Transfer liability to the renter where the issuing agency allows it, or pay it before the due date and charge the renter. Add the ticket-paid tag when they pay, which stops the reminder.

nodes.label: 40 - Wait 3 Days for Payment
41 - Still Unpaid?
42 - Yes: Text a Payment Reminder

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, a reminder about the {{contact.ticket_type}} ticket from {{contact.ticket_date}}: {{contact.ticket_amount}} plus the {{custom_values.ticket_admin_fee}} admin fee. You can pay here: {{custom_values.payment_link}}. Reply if you have any questions. {{location.name}}

nodes.label: 43 - No: Paid, Nothing More to Send

input_sample.message: Need a car Friday to Monday for a family visit. Is the Camry open?

sent: Ticket text with the admin fee and payment link
output_sample.task: Log the Parking ticket PK-4471093 in the Tickets tab
output_sample.reminder: not sent: ticket-paid was added on day 2
